name: Ring Release
summary: Ring Release is a single-player ring-untangling puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players rotate linked rings until their gaps align and every piece can lift free. It includes 60 handmade puzzles across three collections, introducing fixed pins, closed loops and beads. The game has unlimited undo, solution-checked hints, an inspect view and local progress saving, with mouse, touch and keyboard controls. It is available free in web browsers in English and Turkish. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.
